params.name: account_number
params.description: The RazorpayX account number (Customer Identifier from Dashboard → My Account & Settings → Banking). Required to scope results to a specific account.

params.name: contact_id
params.description: Filter payouts by the contact ID of the recipient.

params.name: fund_account_id
params.description: Filter payouts by fund account ID.

params.name: from
params.description: Unix timestamp. Only payouts created from this timestamp onwards are returned.

params.name: to
params.description: Unix timestamp. Only payouts created before this timestamp are returned.

params.name: count
params.description: Number of payouts to return. Default: 10. Maximum: 100.

params.name: skip
params.description: Number of payouts to skip. Use for pagination. Default: 0.

items.docs: List payouts for a given RazorpayX account. Filter by contact, fund account, date range, or status.

Disburse funds via NEFT, RTGS, IMPS, UPI, or card. Supports standard payouts (fund_account_id), composite payouts (contact + fund account inline), card payouts (PCI DSS required), and mobile number payouts (resolved via NPCI mapper). Idempotency header X-Payout-Idempotency (UUID v4, 4–36 chars) is mandatory since March 15, 2025. Never generate a new idempotency key while a payout is in 'processing' state.
Fetch details of a specific payout by its ID.

params.name: payout_id
params.description: Unique identifier of the payout to cancel.

items.docs: Only payouts in 'queued' status can be cancelled.

params.name: payout_id
params.description: Unique identifier of the payout to approve.

items.docs: Requires Payouts Approval workflow enabled and Technology Partner status with OAuth.

params.name: payout_id
params.description: Unique identifier of the payout to reject.

items.docs: Requires Payouts Approval workflow enabled and Technology Partner status with OAuth.
